integrity: The proof separately checks local Join-Property applicability, generalized-lowness, countability at the level of reals, absence of isolated points, and the topological classification step.
scientific_limitations: The conclusion applies to extensions with the local Join Property supplied by Cintioli, not to every special Pi-zero-one class or every globally Join-Property class.
The result is topological and does not classify the internal Turing-degree order of a jump fibre.
No effective or uniform homeomorphism with the rationals is claimed.
title: Cintioli extensions split into dense rational jump fibres
